protocol.name: panoptes_window_v1

description.summary: windows as the compositor places them

protocol.description:
Lists every managed toplevel window with what an agent needs to act on it: the process that owns it, its app_id and title, where it sits, the window it is a dialog of, and whether it has keyboard focus. A client can focus or close any window.
Popups, such as menus and tooltips, are not listed, nor are X11 override-redirect windows.

interface.name: panoptes_window_manager_v1
interface.description: On bind the compositor sends xwayland if it runs Xwayland, then a window event for every current window, then each window's initial state. Windows that map later are announced as they map.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Window objects already announced stay valid.

event.name: xwayland
event.description: The DISPLAY value for X11 clients, such as ":1". Sent once on bind, only when the compositor runs Xwayland.

event.name: window
event.description: Its initial state follows on the new object, ended by done.

interface.name: panoptes_window_v1
interface.description: Property events describe the window, and done marks a consistent state. After the initial state the compositor sends only the properties that changed, then done.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The window itself stays open; use close to close it.

description.summary: raise the window and give it keyboard focus

request.name: close

description.summary: ask the window's client to close it

request.description: The client may refuse, or ask its user first.

event.name: pid

description.summary: the process that owns the window

event.description: For a Wayland window, the process on the other end of the client's connection. For an X11 window, the process Xwayland reports for the client's connection. Zero when unknown. Sent once, in the initial state.

event.name: app_id
event.description: The xdg_toplevel app_id, or the class of an X11 window's WM_CLASS. Empty when the client sets none.

event.name: title
event.description: Empty when the client sets none.

event.name: geometry
event.description: The window's box in output layout coordinates, without client-side shadows: for an xdg toplevel, its window geometry. With one output at scale 1 these are output pixels: the space of screenshots and of absolute pointer motion.

event.name: parent

description.summary: the window this one is a dialog of

event.description: Null for a main window, and for a parent that is not listed.

description.summary: whether the window has keyboard focus
the properties sent so far form one state

event.name: closed
event.description: No more events follow, and the compositor ignores requests on the object. The client should destroy it.
